title: CDC Vouchers eligibility for related family nuclei living at the same address
asked: Dr Hamid Razak asked whether the Ministry will review CDC Vouchers eligibility to account for caregiving arrangements where related but distinct family nuclei live at the same registered address, and whether alternative criteria could recognise them as separate households.
response: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong said the CDC Vouchers Scheme is broad-based and helps all Singaporean households with daily expenses. He said it is complemented by schemes for different family circumstances, including Assurance Package Cash, Child LifeSG Credits and the Silver Support Scheme. For caregivers, he cited increased subsidies for long-term care services and enhancements to the Home Caregiving Grant and Seniors’ Mobility and Enabling Fund, plus the Migrant Domestic Worker Levy Concession. He said the Government will continue to regularly review measures to ensure Singaporeans in need receive appropriate support.

key_points.point: It is complemented by schemes for different family circumstances, including Assurance Package Cash, Child LifeSG Credits and Silver Support Scheme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: The CDC Vouchers Scheme is complemented by schemes that support the different family circumstances of Singaporean households, such as the Assurance Package Cash, Child LifeSG Credits and the Silver Support Scheme for eligible households.

key_points.point: For caregivers, subsidies for long-term care services have increased and the Home Caregiving Grant and Seniors’ Mobility and Enabling Fund have been enhanced.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: For caregivers, the Government has, over the years, increased subsidies for long-term care services and enhanced the Home Caregiving Grant and the Seniors’ Mobility and Enabling Fund to provide greater financial relief to caregivers.

key_points.point: Caregivers can apply for the Migrant Domestic Worker Levy Concession.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Caregivers can also apply for the Migrant Domestic Worker Levy Concession if they need more help to care for their loved ones.

key_points.point: The Government will continue to regularly review measures to ensure Singaporeans in need receive appropriate support.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: The Government will continue to regularly review our measures to ensure Singaporeans in need of help will receive the appropriate support.

key_points.point: He will take the Member's feedback back to consider.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: I thank the Member, Dr Hamid Razak, for providing that feedback and we will most certainly take it back to consider.

left_open: Whether the CDC Vouchers eligibility framework will be reviewed specifically for related but distinct family nuclei at the same registered address.
Whether alternative criteria may be used to recognise related but distinct family nuclei as separate households.
supplementary: Supplementary questions focused on CDC Voucher eligibility for related family nuclei sharing an address and a possible calibrated approach for larger households.
